The room

Log walls, every screen lit, a dog under the table.

Pool, darts, pinball and the games on all night. Bring the crew.

Same room, new smoke

Opened as 6 Bucks in 2022. Then the smoker moved in.

6 Bucks was the bar where everything on the menu cost six dollars — a small room off 410 that filled up fast on Tuesday nights. In 2026 the name on the sign changed to Bonney Lake Barbecue: brisket, burnt ends and pulled pork smoked every morning, a tap list that rotates, and the same trivia crowd at the same tables.

Six bucks still means something here — it's the price of a premium cocktail at happy hour.
